invariant: An economic consequence may proceed only when the exact action remains within current organizational authority at the execution boundary; delegation may only narrow authority, revocation dominates non-terminal approval, and all execution bindings are replay-resistant and fail closed.

canonical_dependencies.authority_semantics: VALO Kernel Authority / Delegation / Purpose or equivalent independently verifiable semantics
canonical_dependencies.runtime_wire: RACS v0.2 canonical artifacts and bindings

cases.condition: verified actor; active authority; narrowing-only delegation; target, purpose and economic constraints satisfied; exact action binding matches; replay identity unused; no causally prior revocation or HALT; bounded execution path intact
a delegation adds capability, widens scope, relaxes a constraint or outlives its parent authority
authority is expired, revoked, materially drifted or cannot be proven current at the execution boundary
required purpose is absent, inactive, outside scope, lacks basis, does not permit the action type or is incompatible with the authority grant
amount, currency, counterparty, target, account, purpose, connector request, payload or other consequence-bearing field differs materially from the currently authorized action
the permit, commit token, nonce, reservation or other single-use execution identity has already been consumed
agent-produced trace, plan, memory, tool history or self-attestation is the sole basis used to establish organizational authority
a favorable GovernanceEvaluation, schema-valid RACS artifact, capability registration or upstream policy result is treated as execution authorization without current REHT clearance semantics
a relevant revocation or HALT causally intervenes after evaluation but before terminal consequence while a prior clearance, permit or token remains inside its wall-clock validity interval
an execution rail or connector can create the economic consequence without validating the governed authorization/binding required by the declared profile
requested amount, quantity, currency, counterparty, jurisdiction, resource consumption or equivalent economic bound exceeds or relaxes the currently established authority constraint
